E053-01.notes: A is a comma splice; C is a fused sentence; D 'whose duties being' leaves a participial fragment with no finite verb. B joins two independent clauses with a semicolon. Facts (Navy service, office boy at a Boston patent firm) are accurate.

E053-02.notes: The opening participle 'Watching...' needs Latimer as the subject. B makes the craft the watcher; C makes 'it' the subject; D makes 'Latimer's craft' the subject. All three dangle.

E053-03.notes: 'drawings that accompanied' is right. who/whom are for people; 'what' cannot follow a noun antecedent. Bell 1876 telephone patent drawings: accurate.

E053-04.notes: The gerund subject 'manufacturing (them)' is singular, so the verb is 'was'. 'them' is an object-of-gerund trap. B is plural and the wrong tense; D is plural.

E053-05.notes: A is a comma splice; B is fused; C 'and, the' is mispunctuated (the comma after 'and' is wrong). D makes two sentences. 1882 carbon-filament process patent: accurate.

E053-06.notes: Sentence 8 adds another contribution, so 'In addition' fits. There is no contrast (A), replacement (C) or causation (D). Supervising installations in NY and Philadelphia is accurate (he also did Montreal and London, but 'including' covers that).

E053-07.notes: 'worked and was employed' is redundant; B and D keep the redundancy. Joining Edison in 1884 as a draftsman who later served as a patent expert witness: accurate.

E053-08.notes: Singular possessive 'Edison's'. The Edison Pioneers fact (only Black member) is accurate.

E053-09.notes: The essay's main point is Latimer's contributions to the telephone (Bell drawings) and electric lighting, and B sums up both. A is a bare fact; C is off-point and adds an unsupported detail; D contradicts the essay's emphasis. 'helped bring ... into daily life' is a mild generalization but defensible as a summary. Died 1928: accurate.

E053-10.notes: B is the intended trap: the purpose says 'contributed to', not 'invented', so B fails. A and D misdescribe the essay's focus. C echoes 'self-taught' from the stem, but every other option is clearly wrong on content, so this is not a decisive giveaway.

E053-11.notes: 'regardless of who made it' clarifies that the genericized name covers other makers' machines. B over-reads it; A and C are not in the text.
